notes.title: Patch 1.06 - added Hardcore mode and quest reset option
notes.content:
Gameplay/balance

-Hardcore mode permadeath is now available.

-If the player completes quest 13 (Ra quest) and has level 95, players can reset the quest list for 5000 gold and replay all quests on Nightmare or Hell difficult.

-The player can no longer play on normal difficulty if it hits level 95.

-You can now enter the Ra and Elemental King quest area at level 85 minimum.

[strike]-Nightmare difficulty is available from a minimum of previous level 30 to level 60 now

-Hell difficulty is available from a minimum of previous level 70 to level 95 now.[/strike]

Items:

-Added 4 new unique items
-You can now gamble weapons.

Item drop rate:

-Steelmoor wilderness loot pool level 1 drops decreased.



edit: 

Patch 1.06b

-Fixed an auto-aim bug that sometimes happened when returning a quest item to an NPC. 



edit:

Patch 1.06c

-Nightmare and Hell Difficulty are now only available from level 95 due to drop rate balance.

-Some map mistakes fixed in Glacial Plateau

-Spelling mistakes fixed

-Increased stats on some monsters in the Glacial Plateau

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - Player personal chest storage update
notes.content:
Quality of life update:

Players can now store items in their personal storage chest

Balance: 



 -Some monsters that spawn below player level 25 in Magic Woods have increased stats on damage and health 

-Some monsters that spawn below player level 25 in Magic Woods, have there damage changed from physical to fire or cold damage. 

-Starter blood summoner weapons are increased in damage 

-Blood Summoner Giant Magic Ball skill decreased in mana use 



 Bugs:

-Fixed a bug where the health globe sometimes did not update correctly.
-Fixed a bug where opening the options menu could bug auto-aim

notes.title: Patch 1.04 – Fixed bugs, animations and game balance.
notes.content:
bug fixes and tweaks: 



-Sound menu bugs fixed; sound would sometimes spike on swapping menu screens.

-Fixed a bug where player health did not update correctly upon gaining a level and wearing items that  added health

-Fixed a bug where health sometimes would not update properly on area/level switch

-Fixed some object-popping bugs in Steelmoor Town

-Fixed Blood Summoner globe ball spell with health bar glitch on monsters

-Lizard monster-type walk animations improved; the animations were too slow.

-Town Thief attack animations improved



Drop rate:



-Uber Alcana drop rate increased for Uber Goro scroll



Game balance:



-Some monsters in higher-level areas have upgraded stats and increased difficulty.

-Royal Woods and Bandit Woods no longer scale health based on player level for monsters, except for       quest monsters. 

-Some monsters in the Chaos Realm have their level increased for better XP.

-Town Thief monster level increased from 35 to 40.

notes.title: Patch 1.03b - Fixed some minor issues and bugs
notes.content:
bugs and quality fixes:



-Item shop potions have a better readable colour, for some reason in the build version the colour was not that clear.



-The item shop now feels better clicking on the menu, it no longer moves the character around.



-Potions now have a stack of 99 in shops.



-Druid +fire skills now show up properly on the stats panel.



-Townzones now push monsters out of boundaries better.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Improved controls with auto-aim and added 2 more classes
notes.content:
Content:



-Added Druid class and Blood Summoner class

-Some unique items slightly changed

-Added more items, there are over 400 in the game now



Shop:



Improved the item shops for a better experience.



Gameplay:



- The spells Z, X and V now have auto-aim targeting the nearest enemy

-Improved on attack animation cooldown timing.

-Players can always change their class for 10,000 gold if they don't want to fully reset and redo everything.      

-Starting Level 1 players will spawn in Steelmoor Farm from now on.



NOTE: If you have an old save file of the mage, there is a special button in the player stats screen to the left of the screen you can click to restore the class type Since patch 1.03 works differently now with classes, etc.

If there are any bugs or problems/questions you can post that into the discussion forums, have fun with Core of Magic patch 1.03.
